== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Probe Droid: the entry “Probe Droid” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 107. Image for [[Probe Droid (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 107 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.

SHA-1 <code>9384d4c95b084abf922779954e9e894b411bf996</code>, SHA-256 <code>e8a47a64799e84ff17852e50ac81a68a5ce6fe79408b6dc44df14bb39d2c9325</code>.
